prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with light blonde hair in a high ponytail wearing a white long-sleeve crop top and white loose pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04", "P05", "P06", "P07", "P08"].

message.content: {"matches":["P04"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"Only P04 has light blonde hair styled in a high ponytail and is wearing a white long-sleeve crop top with white loose pants. All other individuals either have darker hair, different hairstyles, or different clothing (e.g., P06 has long light hair but not in a high ponytail, P07 wears shorts, P01–P03 have darker hair)."}

parsed.reason: Only P04 has light blonde hair styled in a high ponytail and is wearing a white long-sleeve crop top with white loose pants.
